keyVerseDR: "And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with thy whole heart and with thy whole soul and with thy whole mind and with thy whole strength." (Mk 12:30)

level1.title: The Most Important Rule
level1.story: A scribe asked Jesus which commandment is first. Jesus said, "Love God with all your heart." The second is, "Love your neighbor as yourself."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What is the most important rule?
How can you love someone today?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me love God and everyone. Amen.

activity.intro: Color up as you love with your whole heart.
levels: I pray with my whole heart

level2.title: The First Commandment
level2.story: A scribe asked Jesus, "Which is the first commandment of all?" Jesus answered, "Hear, O Israel: the Lord thy God is one God." He said, "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with thy whole heart, and with thy whole soul, and with thy whole mind, and with thy whole strength." The second is this: "Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself." Jesus told the wise scribe, "Thou art not far from the kingdom of God."
level2.keyLine: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with thy whole heart.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does loving God with your mind look like?
Why are the two commandments joined?
level2.prayer: Lord, I love You with all my heart. Amen.
